# Purity Haus

Purity Haus is Susan’s elevated salon experience in Middle Tennessee, centered on personalized healthy-hair care, beauty, confidence and one-on-one attention.

## Primary pages
- / — Purity Haus salon overview and booking
- /services.html — salon service categories and Vagaro booking
- /susan.html — Susan, founder and stylist
- /purity-of-hearts.html — one-on-one coaching for individuals and business owners
- /contact.html — booking and contact options

## Authoritative external links
- Booking: https://www.vagaro.com/purityhaus
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/purityhaus/

## Key facts
- Salon appointments are completed through Vagaro.
- Live service names, prices, durations and availability are maintained on Vagaro.
- Purity of Hearts is Susan’s one-on-one coaching service for individuals and business owners.
